description: Index local source files into the cachly semantic cache so AI assistants can use semantic_search to find relevant files instead of re-reading the whole codebase every time. Walks a directory recursively, reads each matching file, and stores a summary + path as a semantic cache entry (prompt = file path + content excerpt, value = relative path). Requires an embedding provider (OPENAI_API_KEY or CACHLY_EMBED_PROVIDER + key). Run once, then re-run after major refactors. TTL=86400 (24h) keeps entries fresh.

dir.description: Absolute path to the directory to index (e.g. /Users/you/myproject/src)

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to index (default: 100)

namespace.description: Semantic namespace to store under (default: cachly:sem:code)

summary_chars.description: Characters to use as summary per file (default: 1200)

ttl.description: TTL in seconds for indexed entries (default: 86400 = 24 h)

name: index_project
